Embedded Browserify utility closure in ag-psd/dist/bundle.js

The published ag-psd 29.0.0 browser artifact is a Browserify bundle.  Its
module table contains the Node/browser utility closure below even though those
packages are not dependencies in ag-psd's package.json.  Module numbers are the
numbers in the published bundle; they are evidence of what is shipped.

Embedded package/version status:
  Browserify embeds source files, not their package.json files.  The package
  version and exact source commit for every item below are unknown and are not
  asserted.  The primary repository links are provenance for the source and
  license, not a claim that the current repository contents equal the embedded
  revision.

Modules and primary repositories:
  module 17  array-filter
    https://github.com/juliangruber/array-filter
  module 18  available-typed-arrays
    https://github.com/inspect-js/available-typed-arrays
  module 21  call-bound
    https://github.com/ljharb/call-bound
  module 22  call-bind
    https://github.com/ljharb/call-bind
  module 24  for-each
    https://github.com/ljharb/for-each
  modules 25,26  function-bind
    https://github.com/ljharb/function-bind
  module 27  get-intrinsic
    https://github.com/ljharb/get-intrinsic
  modules 28,29  has-symbols
    https://github.com/inspect-js/has-symbols
  module 30  has
    https://github.com/tarruda/has
  module 32  inherits
    https://github.com/isaacs/inherits
  module 33  is-arguments
    https://github.com/inspect-js/is-arguments
  module 34  is-generator-function
    https://github.com/inspect-js/is-generator-function
  module 35  is-typed-array
    https://github.com/inspect-js/is-typed-array
  modules 52, _process  process browser shim
    https://github.com/shtylman/node-process
  modules 53,54,55  util browser port and support modules
    https://github.com/browserify/node-util
  module 56  which-typed-array
    https://github.com/inspect-js/which-typed-array

Attribution names recoverable from primary package metadata (copyright years
are intentionally omitted because the embedded revisions are unknown):
  array-filter: Julian Gruber
  available-typed-arrays, call-bind, call-bound, es-abstract,
    get-intrinsic, has-symbols, is-arguments, is-generator-function,
    is-typed-array, which-typed-array: Jordan Harband / Inspect JS
  for-each, function-bind: Raynos
  has: Thiago de Arruda; Jordan Harband is listed as a contributor
  inherits: Isaac Z. Schlueter and contributors
  process: Roman Shtylman and browser-process contributors
  util: Joyent, Inc. and other Node contributors

The source comments in module 55 preserve the Node/Joyent MIT notice.  The
package metadata for the source packages identifies every module in this list
as MIT except inherits, which is ISC.  The complete terms are reproduced
below; individual package copyright years are not recoverable from the
published Browserify artifact, so this file does not invent them.  The source
links above are the exact primary provenance available from the bundle.
